query:
SELECT mv.id, mv.userId, mv.status, mv.adminNotes, u.name, u.email,
       mp.id as profile_id, mp.university, mp.major
FROM mentor_verifications mv
INNER JOIN users u ON mv.userId = u.id
LEFT JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON mv.userId = mp.userId
WHERE mv.status = 'rejected';
